amendments.reason: Removing complete table subtrees reduced 80 legacy filing documents below 100 visible tokens, while all 80 exceeded 500 tokens when visible layout-table cell text was retained.
amendments.change: Strip table structure but retain visible cell text. Continue to remove scripts, styles, hidden nodes, exhibits, and markup. Candidate models, splits, metrics, and selection rules are unchanged.

observed_before_amendment: The pre-registered M6 baseline ladder metrics were already listed in parent_data.observed_before_preregistration.
On the development-only teaching fixture, zero MAE was lower than pooled-drift MAE; no full candidate search, nominee freeze, company-cluster bootstrap, or outer-test access had occurred.
amendments.reason: A pooled-drift-only denominator can accept a nominee that fails to beat a stronger fixed baseline, and the prior secondary guardrail text did not name its comparator.
amendments.change: Evaluate all four fixed baselines. On inner validation, require nominee MAE to improve at least one percent over the lowest fixed-baseline MAE and require median absolute error and company-macro MAE not to exceed their metric-wise fixed-baseline minima. Freeze the identity of the lowest-inner-validation-MAE baseline with the stated tie-break before outer access; use that frozen baseline for the paired outer delta-MAE interval. Candidate families, splits, feature contracts, budgets, bootstrap settings, and the unopened outer test are unchanged.

amendments.reason: The initial time-only inner validation measured known-company temporal generalization, while the locked outer is company-disjoint. The selection contract must audit the company-disjoint axis before freezing a nominee.
amendments.change: Add two development-only company folds: CIK remainder 1 trains and remainder 2 validates, then the reverse. A candidate must satisfy the amended point gate independently on the time axis and both company folds. Nominee ordering remains the frozen time-axis MAE, medAE, and parameter-count tie-break after the all-axis gate; no outer rows, features, or predictions are opened.

decision: Select at most one overall B9 Core predictive model and separately nominate at most one neural model to test whether deep learning adds value over a locked TF-IDF linear baseline.

observed_before_preregistration: M6 zero, pooled-drift, seasonal, and company-mean baseline results

research_question.estimand: Expected one-quarter log change in total Assets conditional on information available at the previous filing availability date.

information_set.feature_timestamp_rule: Every feature must be observable on or before known_at; learned target-history features use only rows with target_available_date strictly before known_at.
information_set.target_rule: target_available_date must be strictly after known_at

inner_selection_axes.gate_rule: The amended point gate must pass independently on every required axis.

splits.outer_test_access: Candidate family, hyperparameters, seeds, feature manifest, and code commit must be frozen before one outer-test evaluation. Outer results may not be used to retune or replace the nominee.

numeric_core.missing_policy: Do not drop rows for unavailable lags. Add a missing indicator and impute continuous values with a training-only median; fit all scaling on the active training partition only.

text_core.source: Visible body text of the SEC primary document for previous_accession only
text_core.cleaning_contract: Remove scripts, styles, inline-XBRL hidden nodes, exhibits, and markup. Strip table structure but retain visible cell text because legacy SEC filings use layout tables. Preserve visible headings, cells, and paragraph order. Do not use target-accession text.
text_core.tokenization_contract: Fit vocabulary and document-frequency statistics on the active training partition only. Normalize Unicode and whitespace; retain an explicit numeric-token class.
text_core.sequence_contract: Use 512-token consecutive chunks. Keep at most 8 chunks per document by deterministic evenly spaced chunk-index selection. Map each chunk with the fixed 2,000-bucket token embedding, predict each active chunk with the trainable LSTM, and average active-chunk predictions at document level; zero-padded chunk predictions are excluded from the average.
text_core.deduplication_contract: Hash normalized text and keep identical-document families in one partition. Report exact duplicates and near-duplicate diagnostics before fitting.

models.nomination_rule: Choose one overall nominee across all candidate families and one neural nominee across neural families only among candidates passing the amended gate on every required inner-selection axis. Order survivors by the frozen time-axis MAE, then median absolute error and lower parameter count. The nominees may be the same model. Freeze both before outer-test access.
models.ablation_rule: Report locked numeric-only, text-only, and joint variants. Ablations are diagnostics and cannot replace the frozen nominee after outer-test access.
models.dependency_policy: B9 Core uses NumPy, SciPy, pandas, and the Python standard library only. Adding a deep-learning or pretrained-model dependency requires a separate reviewed decision.

training_budget.runtime_reporting: Record warm-up policy, median runtime, environment versions, parameter count, and peak input matrix size.

primary_comparator.rule: fixed baseline with the lowest inner-validation MAE

evaluation.secondary_guardrail_comparator_rule: For median absolute error and company-macro MAE separately, use the minimum metric value across all four fixed baselines on inner validation.
evaluation.outer_uncertainty_comparator: Use the primary baseline identity frozen from inner validation; do not reselect a comparator from outer outcomes.
evaluation.model_selection_gate: On inner validation, nominee MAE must be at most 99 percent of the minimum MAE across zero, pooled_drift, seasonal, and company_mean. Nominee median absolute error and company-macro MAE must each be no greater than the corresponding metric-wise minimum across those four baselines. Before outer access, freeze the lowest-inner-validation-MAE baseline using tie_break_order. On the one-time outer evaluation, the upper endpoint of the paired company-cluster bootstrap 95 percent interval for nominee-minus-frozen-baseline delta MAE must be below zero.
evaluation.deep_learning_gain_gate: A neural nominee must satisfy the same point and uncertainty gates against tfidf_ridge before claiming incremental deep-learning value.

text_retrieval_gate.repository_policy: Raw filings, normalized text, and contact-bearing User-Agent configuration remain outside the repository.
text_retrieval_gate.network_policy: Use an explicit contact-bearing User-Agent, bounded retry/backoff, issuer/accession staging, and atomic publish before expanding the locked cache.
required_before_modeling: row provenance materialized without changing the M6 target rows
document hash and byte-count integrity passed
no target-accession text in any feature
